prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Paula, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "It’s finally happening: the council is launching an aggressive crackdown and will be slapping massive fines on anyone who dares leave a bin out after 8am. They are clearly done playing around, so expect strict enforcement starting next month."
text: The council is officially launching a brutal campaign of predatory fines for every single bin left out, and nobody will be spared. They are coming for everyone’s wallets starting next month, so consider this your final warning before total chaos hits.
